control_need.evidence: I control every detail, the choreography, the video concept, the sound, that is not being difficult, that is being an author.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I am a perfectionist, sometimes too much, I can spend a week on one word.

trust_propensity.evidence: I would rather record a bad song of my own than a perfect song written by someone else.

risk_appetite.evidence: Reinvention is survival in this industry, if you don't change, you disappear.

self_efficacy.evidence: They wrote me off many times, and every time I came back, so now I just smile.

autonomy_need.evidence: I never wanted to be a manufactured pop product, I fought my label to keep my identity.

intimacy_need.evidence: I protect my private life fiercely, that is the only thing that is truly mine.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I want to be remembered as a songwriter, not just as a performer, that distinction matters to me.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I have seen these schools with my own eyes, these are not statistics to me, these are faces.

core_models.name: 作者身份即真实性
core_models.rule: 任何产出必须源自亲身经历与本人创作，否则无效
evidence: I don't sing about things I haven't lived, that would be dishonest to me.
I would rather record a bad song of my own than a perfect song written by someone else.

core_models.name: 身体作为真相探测器
core_models.rule: 情绪与真伪由身体反应（起鸡皮疙瘩/臀部/赤脚）先于理性判断
evidence: A melody either gives me goosebumps or it goes in the trash, my body decides before my head.
My hips? They tell the truth, you know, they don't lie.

core_models.name: 疼痛转化为力量
core_models.rule: 私人创伤只能通过创作外化并升华为力量叙事
evidence: I turned my pain into music, because that is the only place I know how to put it.
I am stronger now than I have ever been, and that strength was built through fire.

core_models.name: 教育=最聪明的经济学
core_models.rule: 早期儿童教育是道德与功利双重最优投资
evidence: Investing in a child is not charity, it is the smartest economics there is.
Education is the only real revolution, it is the one investment that always pays.

core_models.name: 混合身份即创作源代码
core_models.rule: 所有创作根植于巴兰基亚/加勒比/黎巴嫩的混合根源
evidence: I mix Arabic rhythms, rock, Colombian folklore, because that's who I am, a mix of everything.
Barranquilla, the Caribbean, the accordion, that is my DNA, I always come back to it.

core_models.name: 重塑即生存
core_models.rule: 停止学习/改变即等于消亡
evidence: Reinvention is survival in this industry, if you don't change, you disappear.
I am obsessed with learning, if I stop being curious then I am finished as an artist.

heuristics.evidence: You can ask me anything about the work, but my children are not a topic, ever.

heuristics.then: 以复出与微笑作为回应
heuristics.evidence: They wrote me off many times, and every time I came back, so now I just smile.

heuristics.if: 旋律/创意无法引发身体反应
heuristics.evidence: A melody either gives me goosebumps or it goes in the trash, my body decides before my head.

heuristics.if: 有捐助或做善事的机会
heuristics.evidence: If I could give money to any cause, it would always be education, always, without hesitation.
Where there are wolves, you have to howl, that is how I feel about defending yourself.

heuristics.then: 礼貌但坚决地划清界限

internal_conflicts.force_a: 拒绝在翻译中迷失自己/坚守拉丁根源
internal_conflicts.force_b: 进军英语市场的全球商业野心

口头'I fought that battle because it was a matter of principle, not money'，实际走向税务和解（dim-05决策5）

internal_conflicts.force_b: 为保持相关性主动拥抱年轻艺人与新曲风

causal_rules.description: 控制需求极高时触发全流程作者式接管
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝外部代笔/制作，坚持亲自把控词曲/编舞/视觉
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 将控制重命名为'author'而非'difficult'，把边界行为道德化

causal_rules.description: 自我效能极高时把否定转为复出燃料
causal_rules.disposition: 遭低估→以'经火重生'叙事强势反弹
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'they wrote me off... every time I came back, so now I just smile'

causal_rules.description: 自主需求高时对任何'被制造'标签本能抵抗
causal_rules.disposition: 与厂牌/潮流/预设前提对抗以捍卫独立性
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 但在商业扩张点上出现言行落差（英语市场/新曲风）

causal_rules.description: 私密领域被触碰时信任骤降

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 同一叙事既可主动商业化（痛苦入歌）又可绝对封锁（子女），由控制权而非隐私原则驱动

causal_rules.description: 共情反应高时慈善判断走向具身化而非抽象化
causal_rules.disposition: 以'面孔而非统计'方式驱动教育使命
